entries.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible in the entry observation.
entries.guidance: Search visible receptacles in the order presented in the room observation. At each location, navigate to the receptacle, open it if closed, and inspect for the requested object. Once the requested object is acquired, stop generic search and follow the task-required downstream routine.

entries.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring cleaning an acquired object before final placement.
entries.guidance: After acquiring the target object, use the carrier's direct cleaning operation (clean <object> with <sinkbasin>) when a suitable sinkbasin is available, then continue the task-required downstream placement.
